verdict.rationale: Letta publishes a pricing page that confirms a free way to start: BYOK models, including ChatGPT/Codex, Kimi and Z.AI coding plans, are free. The page also describes a tier capped at up to 20 stateful agents and a developer plan with unlimited agents billed on usage. However, the evidence never states actual per-unit rates, so a platform engineer cannot project memory costs from it. Missing for 10: concrete per-unit rates (per token, step, agent or memory/storage), plan prices, memory-specific cost dimensions, independent corroboration of pricing.
